description: This PHP source file defines functions and classes related to creating, serializing, and localizing meta strings within the TestLink project. It includes functions for creating localized strings with or without firing localization events, and classes for managing localized string objects with support for parameters and serialization.

classes.name: tlMetaStringHelper
classes.description: A helper class serving as a container for string label, parameters, and localization flags used by tlMetaString.

classes.name: tlMetaString
classes.description: A class representing a localizable string with support for parameters, serialization, and localization logic.

methods.name: TLS
methods.description: Creates a tlMetaString object with localization and optionally fires localization events.

methods.name: _TLS
methods.description: Creates a tlMetaString object without firing localization events.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes a tlMetaString object with a label and parameters.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a tlMetaString object into a string for storage.

methods.name: unserialize
methods.description: Creates a tlMetaString object from its serialized string representation.

methods.name: localize
methods.description: Returns the localized string, replacing parameters with their values.
